notes: Needs ruling (rule 11): the report opens «رجال الكشي:», a source known by its title; the chain is quoted from that book, and the book's own author is not written.
«إبراهيم ابنا نصير» is one surface (the text's dual apposition); «غير واحد» is unnamed; the Imam is written after «عن» and so stays a narrator (ruling 2).
The leading «[-/1]» is a reference marker and is left out.
